blockers.detail: yantra-storage/YANTRA_STORAGE_HTTP_SEND waits for the yantra-storage HTTP send and signatures patch (1.4.1) to be published
yantra-voicebox/YANTRA_VOICEBOX_TRANSCRIBE audioBase64, mimeType, filename waits for the yantra-voicebox transcribe base64 patch (1.0.8) to be published

setup: "Generate French Audio": yantra-storage/YANTRA_STORAGE_HTTP_SEND comes from the yantra-storage HTTP send and signatures patch (1.4.1), which is not published yet; this step fails until it ships, then the template promotes on the next catalog refresh.

"Transcribe Audio": yantra-voicebox/YANTRA_VOICEBOX_TRANSCRIBE sends audioBase64, mimeType, filename, which the yantra-voicebox transcribe base64 patch (1.0.8) adds and which is not published yet; this step fails until it ships, then the template promotes on the next catalog refresh.
Workflow secret ELEVENLABS_API_KEY: ElevenLabs API key for api.elevenlabs.io (xi-api-key: <secret>). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.

hints: "Generate French Audio" authenticated with httpHeaderAuth in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
"Generate French Audio" sends its request body and reads the response as a file with yantra-storage HTTP_SEND (public https hosts only, 25 MB, 120 s).
"Transcribe Audio" authenticated with openAiApi in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
"Transcribe Audio" called OpenAI Whisper over HTTP; it now runs on the platform transcription (no API key) with the audio from "Generate French Audio", and later steps read the text as before.
"Translate English text to speech" authenticated with httpHeaderAuth in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.

notes: 1] In ElevenLabs, add a voice to your [voice lab](https://elevenlabs.io/voice-lab) and copy its ID. Open this node and add the ID there

2] Get your ElevenLabs API key (click your name in the bottom-left of [ElevenLabs](https://elevenlabs.io/voice-lab) and choose ‘profile’)

In this node, create a new header auth cred. Set the name to `xi-api-key` and the value to your API key
3] In the 'credential' field of this node, create a new OpenAI cred with your [OpenAI API key](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys)

### About
This workflow takes some French text, and translates it into spoken audio.

It then transcribes that audio back into text, translates it into English and generates an audio file of the English text
